}}'''Carahuin''' is an [[Aiel]] ''[[Far Dareis Mai]]'' of an unknown clan.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Carahuin}}

== Appearance ==
She has flaxen hair and has eyes like polished sapphires.

== Activities ==
Carahuin was fond of making fun of [[Perrin Aybara|Perrin]] when he blushed at the ''[[gai'shain]]'' who were not yet dressed in white.

She informed [[Verin Mathwin]] that a [[Wise One]] and two ''[[Cor Darei]]'' were killed when [[Katerine Alruddin]] escaped. She is one of the [[Maidens of the Spear]] who are guarding the [[Aes Sedai]] held prisoner by the [[Aiel]] in [[Cairhien]].
